long_biography.plain_text:
Qatar's diplomatic reach expanded during Sheikh Hamad bin Jassim bin Jaber Al Thani's two decades as foreign minister. Known as HBJ, he rose from municipal administration to combine the foreign affairs portfolio with the premiership. He became a leading figure in the country's mediation efforts, where broad political ties and personal contacts helped bring parties together.

Outside government, Sheikh Hamad is a private investor working through personally controlled vehicles. His portfolio spans banking and private companies. Paramount remains a major Deutsche Bank shareholder. A Prime Capital unit holds an investment interest in the German technology company Neura Robotics.
